title: WPSS/236/2020 of NARENDRA SINGH RANA Vs VEER CHANDRA SINGH GARHWALI UTTARAKHAND UNIVERSITY OF HORTICULTURE AND FORESTRY

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPSS No. 236 of 2020
Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.

Ms. Abhilasha Tom ar, Advocate,
holding brief of Mr. Sandeep Kothari,
Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. M.S. Bisht, Brief Holder for the
State of Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the
parties.
Petitioner is a regular em ployee of
Garhwal Dugdh Utpadak Sehkari Sangh
Ltd., Srinagar serving, as Assistant
Accountant. He was sent on deputation
to Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali
Uttarakhand University of Horticulture &
Forestry, Bharsar, Pauri Garhwal, where
he joined duties on 19.04.2014 as I n-charge Finance & Accounts. According to
the petitioner, while on deputation to the
University, he applied for Earned Leave
from 01.01.2018 till 12.01.2018, which
was sanctioned, however, due to illness,
he could not join duties and the Registrar
of the University on 17.01.2018
unilaterally relieved him for joining
duties in his parent organization.
By m eans of this writ petition,
petitioner has sought the following relief:
"a) I ssue a writ, order or direction in the nature
of mandamus directing the respondents to
resolve the issue amongst themselves and
further to take appropriate decision with respect
to the medical leave of the petitioner from
15.01.2018 till 24.08.2018 and further to
release the salary and other consequential
benefits of the aforesaid period."

submits that, after recovery from illness,
petitioner reported for duties on
25.08.2018 and he also applied for
m edical leave between the period
15.01.2018 to 24.08.2018, however, no
decision is taken on his leave application.
She further subm its that respondents are
shifting responsibility to one another and
petitioner is m ade to suffer for no fault
of his.
Certain medical certificates have
been enclosed with the writ petition in
support of the contention that petitioner
was ill during the aforesaid period.
Learned counsel for respondent no.
1, however, points out that the
University is not com petent to take
decision on petitioner's application for
m edical leave, submitted after his
relieving from the University. Thus,
according to him, parent organization of
the petitioner alone can take decision in
the m atter.
Learned counsel for the petitioner,
however, subm its that petitioner's
em ployer is not taking decision in the
m atter on the ground that petitioner
resum ed duties in the parent
organization only on 25.08.2018.
Having regard to the aforesaid
facts, this Court thinks that ends of
justice would be m et, if writ petition is
disposed of by directing the respondents
to sit together and take decision in the
m atter at the earliest.
 Accordingly, writ petition is
disposed of by permitting petitioner to
m ake representation to the respondents,
within two weeks from today. I f such
representation is m ade within the
stipulated period, the Registrar of the
University and Secretary of Garhwal

Dugdh Utpadak Sehkari Sangh Ltd.,
Srinagar shall sit together on any day
within four weeks' from the date of
receipt of petitioner's representation and
take decision on the leave application of
the petitioner. The decision, so taken,
shall be communicated to petitioner
within two weeks thereafter.

( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.)
 10.10.2022
Arpan
